verses.1: Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O Jehovah.
verses.2: Lord, hear my voice: Let thine ears be attentive To the voice of my supplications.
verses.3: If thou, Jehovah, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who could stand?
verses.4: But there is forgiveness with thee, That thou mayest be feared.
verses.5: I wait for Jehovah, my soul doth wait, And in his word do I hope.
verses.6: My soul waiteth for the Lord More than watchmen wait for the morning; Yea, more than watchmen for the morning.
verses.7: O Israel, hope in Jehovah; For with Jehovah there is lovingkindness, And with him is plenteous redemption.
verses.8: And he will redeem Israel From all his iniquities.
